$comment: #811: what the official A2A TCK says of the AGBoss conformance agent (tests/a2a-tck/), checked by scripts/a2a-tck.mjs. Every requirement that does not pass is named here with why, by its id or its id's prefix; one that fails and is not here, or is here and passes, fails the job. Each run also pins its JSON-RPC test counts and the exact tests that fail (failedTests, JUnit `<classname>::<name>`): a listed requirement fails for its reason only.

reasons.tck-defect: one messageId per session fo: The TCK's tck_id(prefix) is one id per session (tck/requirements/base.py), so several requirements send the same messageId with other content. A message's id is unique (a2a.proto Message.message_id); AGBoss deduplicates every messageId per tenant and owner and refuses one reused with other content (-32602, the payment guarantee, #805). tck-defects.patch gives each call its own id.
reasons.tck-defect: no expected_error declared: CORE-SEND-003 says a raw part of an unsupported media type MUST be ContentTypeNotSupportedError, and AGBoss answers -32005 ContentTypeNotSupportedError (ErrorInfo CONTENT_TYPE_NOT_SUPPORTED); the requirement declares no expected_error, so the TCK takes any error as a failure. tck-defects.patch declares it.
reasons.no-file-parts: The tck-artifact-file / tck-artifact-file-url scenarios need an artifact with a file part. AGBoss 0.1.1 has no file parts (epic #805, what it does not do): an output is text or one data part. The text and data variants of DM-ART-001 pass. File parts come with #859.
reasons.always-a-task: The tck-message-response scenario needs a stateless Message answer. Every AGBoss send is a durable task (one task = one execution, #805); the spec allows either (SendMessage answers a Task or a Message). A direct Message answer comes with #860.
reasons.history-is-the-status-message: MAY: AGBoss keeps no task history beyond the status message in 0.1.1 (design §4.1.5, historyLength honoured as the status message only).
